what: Two 1px lines above the CTA row hand off like a baton. On hover the current line exits to the right (110%), and .1s later a new line enters from the left (-110%) and settles (.7s power4.inOut). The arrow at the right end exits the same way and a new arrow enters .05s later (.5s). On release everything goes back the way it came. The ”underline” type has one hidden underline that enters from the left and settles (.6s), then exits to the right on release — for menu links.

options.look: underline — a single hidden underline only (enters -110%→0, exits →110%, .6s)
options.lag: Delay before the second strand arrives (seconds), default line .1 · arrow .05
options.[data-fx-part=line]: Line strands (children) — the default type has two (current line·new line), the underline type has one. If absent the part makes 1px ones at top (default)·bottom (underline)
options.[data-fx-part=arrow]: Arrow (child, two) — stacked inside a 1lh square. Without it the arrow does not move
options.out: underline type — exit duration (seconds), default same as line
options.out-ease: underline type — exit curve, same as the default ease
options.from: Underline type — starting position of the entry (xPercent), default -110
options.to: underline type — exit end position (xPercent), default 110
options.ease: Curve — GSAP name or 0.76,0,0.24,1, default power4.inOut

use: Company About→→ · Menu: Work

from.where: On every page: .tw-cta (About Us · Careers — original .cta-primary’s cta-line-1/2 · cta-arrow-1/2), .tw-cta2 (arrow only), and the header line .tw-uline (original .link-underline --translate)
shared.js navHover · .fo-nav-link (footer nav About, Team, Work, Contact, Social — original nav-hover --xPos −100% → 0 .8s expo.out, on release 105% .6s power4.out)
from.options: look: underline; line: .8; ease: expo.out; out: .6; out-ease: power4.out; from: -100; to: 105

note: The original lights only the current CTA with a single document-wide mouseover — the part uses pointerenter/leave per element. No movement on touch devices
